findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 248 requests to 58 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 39.7 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.6 MB (9%) came from third-party domains, 2.4 MB of it from services classified as tracking (182 requests).

28 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), creativecdn.com (RTB House, advertising), dotomi.com (Conversant, advertising).
83 cookies were set by third-party domains (118 cookies in total).

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 44 requests were blocked. The page still made 248 requests to 58 third-party domains, including 30 tracking services in our list.
